$comment: The defended inventory of static container images this repository's own code
selects — every scanner, linter, policy engine, helper and language runtime
cicd chooses on its own behalf. ADR-004 covers the *other* kind: the container
a consumer's own command runs in, resolved from --toolchain-image or from
.nvmrc / global.json. Those are consumer-controlled, cannot be pinned ahead of
time, and are deliberately absent from this file.
Every digest here is the multi-arch image *index* digest, resolved with
`dagger core container from --address <repository>:<tag> image-ref` and verified
to be identical under --platform linux/amd64 and --platform linux/arm64 — so a
single reference works on CI (amd64 runners) and on local development machines
(including arm64 Macs). Never paste a `docker inspect RepoDigests` value: that
is the single-architecture manifest, which is how the previous build-module
Trivy pin ended up amd64-only.
scripts/check-runtime-image-pins.py checks this file against the source in both
directions: an image the source selects but this file omits is an error, and an
entry no source references any more is an error too. It also refuses an entry
that renovate.json's custom managers would not match, so no pin here can rot
without an update path.
family     the rollback unit — one renovate.json group, one revertable PR
role       scanner | linter | policy | helper | language-runtime
sources    every file that references this exact repository:tag@digest
platforms$comment: The architectures every digest below was verified to resolve on. CI runs
amd64; arm64 is local development. Adding a platform means re-verifying every
discovery$comment: Where the checker looks for image selections. go_roots is walked for every
.go file (generated Dagger SDK trees excluded) and every `.From(...)` argument
is resolved through package constants and local literals. make_files is walked
for Makefile-style assignments, because `make policy-test` launches conftest
directly and claims to run the same image the real gate does.
